_comment: Template for .claude/settings.local.json (which is gitignored). After cloning, run .claude/hooks/install.sh to seed a copy of this file as settings.local.json, then fill in real values for your machine. Skills, hooks, and CLAUDE.md reference these as $VAR_NAME — they are exported into the Claude session's environment via the env block below. NOTE for ccnn: no skill or hook currently references any $VAR_NAME, so nothing here needs filling in today. Notesnook credentials (account password, API tokens) live in a top-level .env file, NOT here. The placeholder below documents the shape for when a future skill needs a per-developer path or host.
